"""Contact-orphan detection for the Meridian CRM integrity-check migration."""


def find_orphans(
    contacts: list[dict],
    accounts: list[dict],
) -> list[str]:
    """Return live orphan contact IDs in ascending primary-key order."""
    live_account_ids = {
        account.get("ACCT_ID", "")
        for account in accounts
        if account.get("DEL_FLG", "") != "Y"
        and account.get("ACCT_ID", "") != ""
    }

    live_contacts = (
        contact
        for contact in contacts
        if contact.get("DEL_FLG", "") != "Y"
    )

    return [
        contact.get("CONT_ID", "")
        for contact in sorted(
            live_contacts,
            key=lambda contact: contact.get("CONT_ID", ""),
        )
        if contact.get("ACCT_ID", "") not in live_account_ids
    ]
